newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Ter Beke off as pig fever spreads.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Ter Beke off as pig fever spreads.

text.p: Shares in Belgian packaged meats firm Ter Beke NV slipped further on Friday as fears the arrival of swine fever in Belgium would push up pork prices further sent investors running for cover.
Ter Beke's share fell 65 francs, or 1.98 percent, to 3,225 francs at the morning fixing for small caps on the Brussels bourse, extending a 2.08 percent fall on Thursday.
Ter Beke said earlier this year it was suffering from what it described as an unjustified rise in Belgian pork prices following a swine fever outbreak in Germany and the Netherlands.

Belgium's Agriculture Ministry said on Thursday the disease, which is not harmful to humans, was now affecting several farms in northern Belgium and expressed doubts it could be contained in the near term.
